cohort: The cohort consisted of 7828 preterm infants born at 24+0 to 31+6 weeks' gestation and admitted to 57 neonatal intensive care units in China.
finding: The use rate of antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) was 78.0% among very preterm infants in Chinese NICUs, with fewer receiving a complete course and significant variability across hospitals, and was associated with increasing gestational age, inborn status, increasing maternal age, maternal hypertension, and premature rupture of membranes.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for infants admitted to NICUs from January 1st, 2019 to December 30th, 2019.
